files.text:
CMOS switched-current sample-and-hold
.include "circuit.spice"
.include "models.spice"
VDD vdd 0 3.3
VOUT out 0 PWL(0 1.2 48u 1.2 48.1u 1.8 58u 1.8 58.1u 1.2 100u 1.2)
VS sample 0 PULSE(3.3 0 8u 1n 1n 21.999u 30u)
IIN vdd iref PWL(0 5u 8u 5u 8.001u 0 30u 0 30.001u 15u 38u 15u 38.001u 0 60u 0 60.001u 30u 68u 30u 68.001u 0 100u 0)
VR reset 0 PWL(0 0 90u 0 90.001u 3.3 95u 3.3 95.001u 0 100u 0)
XDUT vdd 0 iref reset sample out astra_081_cmos_switched_current_memory
.temp 27
.options method=gear reltol=1e-5
* @spec track0 range 0.0000047 0.000005300000000000001 unit=A
* @spec hold0 range 0.0000047 0.000005300000000000001 unit=A
* @spec track1 range 0.000014099999999999999 0.0000159 unit=A
* @spec hold1 range 0.000014099999999999999 0.0000159 unit=A
* @spec track2 range 0.000028199999999999998 0.0000318 unit=A
* @spec hold2 range 0.000028199999999999998 0.0000318 unit=A
* @spec compliance range 0.0000141 0.0000162 unit=A
* @spec cleared range 0 1e-8 unit=A
.control
set filetype=ascii
tran 5n 100u
let io=-i(VOUT)
meas tran track0 FIND io AT=7u
meas tran hold0 FIND io AT=20u
meas tran track1 FIND io AT=37u
meas tran hold1 FIND io AT=50u
meas tran track2 FIND io AT=67u
meas tran hold2 FIND io AT=80u
meas tran compliance FIND io AT=54u
meas tran cleared FIND io AT=94u
write out.raw v(xdut.net0) v(sample) v(reset) i(vout)
quit
.endc
.end
